_recorded_from: tools/list on the sidelineiq-mcp-servers web, farcaster and twitter MCP servers
_recorded_against: LOCAL mcp branch feat/metrics-baseline (migration 024), served over an in-memory transport under MCP_UNKNOWN_KEYS=strict, before merge. Re-record against production after the mcp deploy; a local recording from origin/main has previously matched production byte-for-byte.
_note: The six baseline-instrumentation tool entries, lifted verbatim from real tools/list responses. NEVER hand-author this file: the contract test checks that every key the agents SEND is a key the server ACCEPTS, and a hand-written copy would only re-encode what the agent already believes. Inputs are .strict(), so an undeclared key fails the whole call.

web_record_metric_snapshot.name: web_record_metric_snapshot
web_record_metric_snapshot.description: Record one baseline metric reading (follower count, monthly uniques) for a UTC day. Upserts on (metric, day): the latest reading of a day wins. Call ONLY with a value actually read — a failed read must record nothing, never 0.

metric.description: Which series this reading belongs to

value.description: The reading itself. Never a placeholder: if the count could not be read, do not call this tool.

source.description: Where the number came from: neynar / x_api for automated reads, manual for a value typed in by a person

day.description: UTC calendar day 'YYYY-MM-DD' the reading is for. Omit for today.

detail.description: Optional context stored beside the value, e.g. the account username and following count

web_list_metric_snapshots.name: web_list_metric_snapshots
web_list_metric_snapshots.description: List baseline metric readings, ordered by metric then day. A day with no row means no reading was taken or the read failed — never zero.

web_increment_cta_click.name: web_increment_cta_click
web_increment_cta_click.description: Count one click on an AequOs link from a post page. Aggregate only — stores the day, post slug and which link, nothing about the visitor. Counts only when the slug belongs to a PUBLISHED post; returns counted=false otherwise.

post_slug.description: The injury post slug the click came from

link.description: cta = the 'Get Clinical Guidance' referral button; byline = the AequOs attribution link

web_list_cta_clicks.name: web_list_cta_clicks
web_list_cta_clicks.description: List daily AequOs link click counts from post pages, with totals by link and by post.

farcaster_get_profile_stats.name: farcaster_get_profile_stats
farcaster_get_profile_stats.description: Read the SidelineIQ Farcaster account's own follower and following counts via Neynar /user/bulk, for the FID in SIDELINEIQ_FARCASTER_FID. Used by the daily baseline metrics snapshot. Fails with an error rather than returning 0 when the counts cannot be read.

twitter_get_profile_stats.name: twitter_get_profile_stats
twitter_get_profile_stats.description: Read the authenticated SidelineIQ X account's own follower, following and post counts (GET /2/users/me). Used by the daily baseline metrics snapshot. Fails with an error rather than returning 0 when the counts cannot be read.
